principle.headline: A key is only needed for what the agent cannot do itself.
principle.body: The walk is driven by an agent, and an agent is already a model. It writes the persona bios, the step descriptions and the findings with no API key at all — asking a second model to do that would be paying twice for the same sentence. The gaps are the things a coding agent genuinely cannot produce from a tool call: a PNG of a face, and an MP3 of a voice. Those, and only those, are what a provider is for. An agent that CAN produce them — a host with native image generation — should produce them and skip the key entirely.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.detectNote: Set to 1 for every child process Claude Code spawns, so a script started by the agent sees it. Verified in this environment.
hosts.consequence: Needs an image provider for persona art and a TTS provider for narration. Everything else runs with no key.

hosts.name: Codex
hosts.detectNote: Codex sets CODEX_SANDBOX (and CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED) for sandboxed child processes — confirmed by inspecting the shipped binary. It is NOT set when Codex runs with the sandbox bypassed, so absence proves nothing; use WALKTHROUGH_IMAGE_PROVIDER to state it outright.
hosts.consequence: If the host can produce an image file itself, it should write the plate directly and no image provider is needed.

hosts.name: A shell, CI, or an agent that sets no marker
hosts.detectNote: No marker found. Nothing is assumed about what the caller can do.
hosts.consequence: Treated as a plain shell: capabilities come from configured providers only.

capabilities.name: Capture
capabilities.for: Driving the app and photographing it. This is the walk.
capabilities.without: Nothing can be walked. This is the only hard requirement.

providers.name: Playwright Chromium
providers.note: The default. The only backend that does video and a pinned clock.

providers.name: A Chrome on port 9222
providers.note: The way past an SSO or MFA gate: it reuses a browser a human already signed into.

providers.name: iOS Simulator
providers.note: Real MobileSafari. The only backend where lvh − svh is the actual URL-bar height.

providers.name: Android platform-tools
providers.note: adb screencap and screenrecord against an emulator or a tethered device.

capabilities.name: Writing
capabilities.for: Persona bios, step descriptions, captions, findings, the narration script.
capabilities.without: Nothing degrades when no key is set — the agent writes it.

providers.name: The agent running the walk
providers.note: Always available, by definition. This is why the system asks for no key to produce prose.

providers.name: Azure OpenAI text deployment
providers.note: Only for the unattended scripts that run with no agent in the loop.

capabilities.name: Generated illustration
capabilities.for: Persona portraits, scene-setters, moment shots and the shared stipple plates. All invented, all labelled 'illustration' in the UI, none of it evidence.
capabilities.without: A persona card renders as a typographic panel carrying the two facts that actually identify one — where they enter the product, and how many of their journeys have been walked — and the journey masthead simply omits the portrait. Every page still works, and none of them claims a face that was never drawn.

providers.name: The agent running the walk
providers.note: A host that can generate an image writes the plate directly to public/walkthroughs/<slug>/personas/ and no provider is configured at all.

providers.name: Azure OpenAI image deployment
providers.note: Deployment names are not model names — whatever you provisioned goes in the URL.

capabilities.name: Narration
capabilities.for: The spoken track on a persona story video.
capabilities.without: The story video is not rendered. The journey page it summarises is unaffected.

providers.name: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts
providers.note: Chosen automatically the moment OPENAI_API_KEY is present.

providers.name: Local Kokoro model
providers.note: Weights download on first use to ~/.cache/walkthrough-studio. No key, no account, nothing 350 MB in the repo.

capabilities.name: Target-app credentials
capabilities.for: Reaching gated features in the app being walked.
usedBy: any walk against an app with an auth gate
capabilities.without: The gated feature is recorded as pending with the reason, and a finding is filed. It is never unblocked by editing the app.

providers.name: A $VAR placeholder in projects.json
providers.note: projects.json is committed, so it names the variable and .env.local holds the value.
